item.title: Would anyone use a GummySearch alternative that searched ALL forums?
item.summary: like the idea behind GummySearch, but I’ve always wondered why this type of tool has to stop at Reddit. Would anyone be interested in something that could search and analyze discussions across Reddit, niche forums, community sites, Hacker News, X, Quora, etc. from one place? You could search a topic and find: What people are complaining about Questions people keep asking Product recommendations Problems people are looking to solve Conversations mentioning specific brands or competitors Basically GummySearch, but for forums across the entire web instead of just Reddit. Would this actually be useful to anyone? And if so, what would you use it for? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49237225 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
